set.body: Studio blocker. With occurrence or trial in the key, two matched references both match and ByLeft averages them into M silently. Add a preflight finding (Blocker, or an explicit policy) for matched cardinality != 1 naming the affected keys, and a supported occurrence-aware StudyLayout with its codec.
set.title: UI-B: matched-cardinality preflight and occurrence-aware StudyLayout
